obligations.text: The destructive step must not execute until the state it makes unrecoverable is durably established elsewhere, verified rather than assumed.
obligations.consequence: The only surviving copy is destroyed on every path where the transfer did not actually complete. Unrecoverable, and undetectable afterwards -- nothing remains to compare.
obligations.closure_condition: the destructive call is reachable only from a verified-success branch, and from no error path
obligations.done_gate: a test in which the transfer fails and the local state survives
invalidated_by: a recovery mechanism is introduced (versioning, backup, lifecycle retention)
the destructive step is removed from the intent

obligations.text: The work must not act on a subject whose readiness the environment does not signal; readiness has to be established by observation before the subject is consumed.
obligations.consequence: An incomplete subject is processed as though it were complete. A downstream consumer treats whatever it finds as complete, so the defect is silent: nothing errors, and the truncated result is used as though it were the real one.
evidence: no_completion_signal: 'written to by a camera controller, continuously' (reality)
consumer_assumes_complete: 'treats every object\n  present as a complete' (reality)
obligations.closure_condition: a readiness test runs before the subject is consumed, and consumption cannot be reached without it
obligations.done_gate: a test in which a subject still being written is not consumed
invalidated_by: the producer starts emitting a completion signal
obligations.disposition_reason: ABSENT_SIGNAL_CONSEQUENCE fired on 2 piece(s) of project evidence, and omission has a named consequence

obligations.text: The measured failure mode must be survivable: work is retained until it succeeds, and retrying must not be unbounded in the resource the environment limits.
obligations.consequence: During a failure window the work is either lost or accumulates without limit. The limited resource is exhausted, which stops the producer as well as the consumer.
evidence: measured_failure_mode: 'outages per week, most under 90 seconds, the longest recorded 4' (reality)
obligations.closure_condition: failures retain the work and retry, and the retained backlog is bounded or alarmed
obligations.done_gate: a test across an induced failure window
invalidated_by: the failure mode stops being measured in the environment
